Highlighter fixture

PASSAGE_ONE is the sentence the test selects, long enough to anchor against and distinct enough that a re-anchor cannot land anywhere else on this page.

PASSAGE_TWO exists so a second highlight has somewhere to go, and so the first one has a neighbour it must not be confused with.

Filler so the two passages are not the only text on the page, which is what makes the TextQuote prefix and suffix worth anything at all.
